sources.title: π0.5 A Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization
sources.snippet: The model is first pre-trained on the heterogeneous mixture of training tasks, and then finetuned on mobile manipulator with both low-level action examples and high-level semantic subtask annotations. At runtime, the model first predicts the semantic subtask, and then uses it to condition the action generation.
